title: Custom User Settings: Add Your Own Fields to User Profiles | Orchard Core
description:
A user account holds a user name, an email address and roles, but a site often needs more information about its users: a nickname, a department, a newsletter choice.

The Custom User Settings feature lets you define those fields in the admin. Each group of fields is a section: a content type with the Custom User Settings stereotype, shown as a tab on the Edit User page. A permission controls who can edit each section, and a deployment step exports the values.

In this video:
• What custom user settings are
• Enable the feature
• Create a section with fields and a stereotype
• Fill in a user's section
• Control who can edit a section
• Export the values with a deployment plan
